parent_objective: design a no-PPO source-history update that treats replay retention as an active-set constraint
blocked_by: M1353 rejects direct full-replay escalation because alpha 0.005 is only a tiny diagnostic trust-region point

public_gates: M1354 must not use private holdout
M1354 must preserve actor input contract
M1354 must design replay-aware retention before any new update implementation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run a new actor update

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the M1352 line-search boundary into a designed active-set retention update rather than another post-hoc interpolation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, full replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design uses alpha 0.005 as promoted base
stop if design permits PPO before no-PPO retention probe
stop if design omits M267/M264 or M183/M170 active replay rows
fallback_plan: if replay-aware retention can be expressed with existing artifacts, route to implementation
if terminal margins are missing, route to replay trajectory export design
if action anchors are insufficient, route to lexicographic margin projection design
if branch reaches cadence, route to synthesis before implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1353 routes interpolation result to replay-aware retention design

admission_evidence: M1346 fixed objective update improves exact metrics but fails replay
M1352 shows replay failure is amplitude-sensitive and bounded by M183/M170 at alpha 0.005
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: design specifies replay retention active set

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1354 designs proof-retention machinery and cannot claim anticipatory self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve wrong-history outcome retention on M267/M264 and M183/M170 before any stronger claim
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1336 materialized source-history objective rows plus M267/M264 and M183/M170 boundary replay rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If retention design cannot express the active replay surfaces, route to replay trajectory export or margin projection instead of weakening gates.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A replay-aware retention design can convert M1352's tiny line-search boundary into an active-set update objective that preserves public replay proof surfaces while improving materialized source-history metrics.
success_criteria: design specifies exact source-history objective terms
design specifies M267/M264 and M183/M170 active replay retention terms
design specifies no-PPO implementation admission criteria
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, replay run, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design routes directly to PPO or promotion
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, replay run, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1354 passes as a design milestone only if it specifies replay-aware retention while keeping training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, replay execution, and actor-input changes blocked.
